text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Takarazuka Kinen, Mejiro 
Ryan grew stronger each day, carrying 
various hopes and emotions on her 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The efforts Mejiro Ryan has poured into 
winning are genuine. Mejiro Bright has 
zero doubts about her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin carries dreams built up over 
time. She wants to answer the hopes of 
everyone dreaming through her. No matter 
how strong the foe, she cannot afford to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to answer everyone's voices and 
share a dream together, Ines Fujin's 
passionate Takarazuka Kinen begins now—!
